RecreateWorktree: TUI-only recovery for a task whose worktree was reaped: it rebuilds the worktree from the task's branch on the machine running the TUI. The desktop app has no worktree API surface (it covers OpenWorktree only) and does not run on the host that owns the worktree, so there is nothing for it to act on. Revisit if the GUI gains worktree management.
ToggleListView: 2026-09-05: TUI-first. The flat list view (v) ships in the TUI ahead of the GUI. The engine is already surface-neutral — db.SavedView + internal/taskfilter — and GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/views expose it, so the GUI side is a pure front-end task (a list renderer next to Board.tsx) with no backend work left. Delete this entry when desktop/src grows it.
SavedViews: 2026-09-05: TUI-first, same story as ToggleListView. Saved views are readable and writable over /api/views today; the GUI still needs a picker in FilterBar.tsx to use them. Delete this entry when it has one.
